---
title: "Kali Middleby"
---

I'm a plant ecophysiologist interested in how climate change, particularly warming, shapes plant function and ecosystem resilience. My research integrates physiological, ecological, and modelling approaches to understand how leaves and canopies interact with their thermal environment, and increasingly seeks to scale these processes up to the species and community level. I use natural environmental gradients alongside manipulative experiments — both in-situ and in climate chambers — to study acclimation to heat and drought stress, and the trade-offs between them.

  sites.forEach(site => {
